message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in for you without a password.  
If you’ve forgotten your password, the safest way to regain access is to use the “Forgot password?” link on the login page. That will let you reset it securely. Once you’ve reset it, you can log in normally. If you need step‑by‑step guidance on how to do that, just let me know!
